integrity: All formulas are derived analytically. Standalone exhaustive finite tests and cover-isomorphism checks corroborate, but do not replace the proof. No independent external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed and primitive two-cycle populations only for labelled cubic prism and Möbius ladders with at least three rungs; does not classify transients or basins. The historical enumeration literature is not exhaustively accessible.
title: A Lucas-number seam response in majority oscillations on prism and Möbius ladders
